portalsFound.observation: Official Buenos Aires City catalog offers city parcel polygons as GeoJSON and SHP under CC-BY-2.5-AR, updated about every six months; this claims the autonomous city, not Greater Buenos Aires or Argentina.
Official GeoJSON resource lists parcel identifiers and geometry, but its preview says the file is too large and the direct download did not complete in this environment.
City infrastructure advertises WFS vector downloads, but the parcel layer and working feature URL remain unverified.

A real parcel layer returned three polygons, but outputSR=4326 placed them near Salta (-65.409,-24.755), not Buenos Aires; a bounded Buenos Aires count returned zero. It cannot substantiate Buenos Aires or nationwide coverage.

requests.error: Direct download timed out before a parseable response

requests.assessment: Parcels are near Salta; excluded from Buenos Aires coverage

remainingUncertainty: The city GeoJSON likely provides a full autonomous-city release, but no parcel feature could be inspected through the timed-out download; Greater Buenos Aires extends beyond that boundary.
nextStep: Retrieve the official GeoJSON or discover its WFS layer, save a small city-located polygon sample, then assess completeness.
